_readme: THE ONE PLACE THE NAME LIVES. Edit BRAND_NAME or TAGLINE here, then run: node render/build-brand.js  (it rebuilds the wordmark SVG and PNG files and system/brand.js). Then find-and-replace the old name in the .md guides. Contact values stay as [BRACKETS] until the founder fills them.
TAGLINE: Emerging brands. Delivered to your workday.
_readme_SIGNATURE_LOGO_URL: Optional. The public web address of wordmark/png/wordmark-light-on-white-600w.png once it is hosted on your site. Empty = signature/signature-with-logo.html shows a [DOMAIN] slot; use signature.html until then.
_readme_contact: Your details, used by every document and both signatures. Fill them here (then run bash render/build-pdfs.sh) or in details.html in Chrome. FOUNDER_TITLE is optional: empty prints "Founder". WEBSITE set to "" (empty) leaves the website off everything until the site is public.
name_status: Working name, not cleared. No commercial print run until desk-drop-legal-pack/name-check-log.md clears it.
